$why: Moved out of spec-mode-runner.js reviewRoster on 2026-08-15 (3 of 20).
The roster reviewer is the only adversary the roster has: it is what stops a defective
brief reaching an implementer. Extracted verbatim into a builder first, then pinned byte
for byte on BOTH branches — the documentation section is entirely different prose when
nothing was fetched, and pinning only the populated case would let that branch rot.
The documentation section is one value, assembled by the caller. A template that branches
is a program, and a program cannot be reviewed as prose.
body:
__PERSONA__

THE ROSTER JUST MINTED FOR THIS PROJECT — review every brief below:

__BRIEF_BLOCK__

THE CODELINES THESE BRIEFS DESCRIBE, and what each one declares:
__CODELINE_BLOCK__

THE WORK THE PROJECT WAS ASKED TO DO:
__TICKET_BLOCK__

__DOC_SECTION__

__TOOL_LINE__

Return every defect you can evidence, and nothing you cannot.

Where a finding turns on whether a named dependency or path is present in a codeline, fill in
the verification field as well as writing the prose. The pipeline re-runs that exact check
against the repository and DISCARDS any finding the check refutes — so a careless reading
costs nothing, and a correct one is confirmed independently of how convincingly you argued it.
description: Review every brief in a freshly minted roster and report evidenced defects.
